name: Natron
reason: Open-source compositor without a vendor or country; last release 2.5.0 dates from November 2022, so not actively maintained (dropped 2026-09-19).

name: Slugline
reason: The site names two makers but no company or country, so the vendor line on the card would be incomplete (dropped 2026-09-19).

name: ForsetiFest
reason: Suggested by the maker via the form. Version 1.0.0 of a USD 9.99 local browser tool from a one-person brand (Perunlight Corp, Ukraine) that sells 71+ downloads; too new, no use in the sector shown yet. Review again in April 2027 (dropped 2026-10-06).

name: TKLive
reason: Suggested via the form by an AI agent (tkliveapp.pro). Desktop tool for running TikTok LIVE streams across multiple accounts and OBS instances: creator and live-commerce software, not film or TV production. No vendor name, country or pricing published (dropped 2026-10-06).

name: Teleprompter: Read to Camera
reason: Suggested by the developer via the form. iPhone teleprompter app for solo creators (front camera), version 1.0.6 from one developer; not used in film or TV production, and the vendor site names no company, country or prices (those are only in the App Store) (dropped 2026-10-12).

name: Magic Hour
reason: Suggested by the vendor via the form (magichour.ai). Browser AI image and video generator for social content (face swap, talking photos, meme and headshot generators), built for creators rather than film or TV production. The guide lists no generative video tools; if that category is ever added, review again (dropped 2026-10-20).

name: GearDex
reason: Suggested by the maker via the form as part of a launch-directories campaign (geardex.app). Gear inventory plus website, client galleries and CRM for photographers (its own about page says it is built for photographers), from one developer in Irvine, California. Not film or TV production software; if gear and rental management is ever added as a category, start with tools rental houses use (dropped 2026-10-20).

name: EveryTool4U Screen Recorder
reason: Suggested via the form from a Gmail address. Browser screen recorder (WebM download) on a site with 109 free PDF, image and finance utilities; no vendor, country or film or TV use (dropped 2026-10-20).
